note: One SCB register per claim (register slug = curation file name), all authored from and built against the reviewed sources. Guarded by exact source rows (`source_authority`): choice keeps list `keeper` (1 Label, . Skip) over `narrow`; repeat is the same choice, drifted only in step 2; alternatives keeps `keep` over `other` on a member delivered by two physical rows (data_length blank and 10), its authority naming both; extend copies the 2021 `keeper` list to 2020 (witness 2021); unlabelled does the same from a list with no version label (`list = ""`); rows documents source token 1 as 'Included' (rowskeep is its untouched twin; rowsadded adds a token 0 the source never supplies); labels documents 2020 as the 2019 `Sector` list with the reviewed 14 Landsting/Region equivalence; witness/witnesslater document 2020 from the 2016 / 2017 Status lists (witnessed label certificate, 2017 adds NULL), witnesswrong and witnessoutside name a witness year whose domain differs or is not delivered; contrary documents a 2020 period whose own complete list agrees with the witness, contrarylabel's own list contradicts it, contraryplain has no witness; marker certifies the numbered definition by its Tal marker binding, markerpartial leaves out line 8, markerlater has a 2021 list outside the window; alpha certifies bare LEG/SPEC by the variable's own 'Kategori LEG = legitimation eller SPEC = specialitet' name; support keeps 16310 Erroneous as documentary support beside the authority 16320 Microgyria. Unguarded: pdf documents 2020 from a PDF beside a 2021 source list; pdfcomplete documents a period with its own complete list; pdfnowindow names 2019, which VALUE does not deliver; pdfconflict has two overlapping documented entries. Sentinels: sentinel binds book FIX only from 2020-07-01 on a 2020 delivery; substantive binds FIX2 in 2020 while 2019's same code 99 'Substantive industry' stays a plain source member. Each expected literal is the replaced test's asserted members, window or code; the support label is one word ('Erroneous' for the old 'Erroneous microgyria') because placeholder arguments cannot hold a space.
fails_if: choice/repeat/extend/unlabelled/alternatives: `compile_coding_register` stops accepting a `source_authority` whose records, locators, revision, `raw_codings` and `codings` equal the column's own (e.g. compares `records` against only the column's representative record, so alternatives' second physical row goes stale); rowsadded/markerpartial: the documented authority stops comparing the documented codes with the source tokens or the enumeration lines; markerlater: `marker_binding_fingerprints` stops limiting bindings to the window; labels/witness*: `documented_labels_match` ignores the label equivalence or the witness window; contrarylabel/contraryplain: `compile_coding_selection` lets a documented entry overwrite a contrary or unwitnessed complete source list; alpha: the kategori enumeration stops certifying bare codes; support: `[[coding.support]]` drops the authority member or keeps the erroneous one; pdf*: documented PDF coding overwrites a complete list, applies to an undelivered period, or lets one of two overlapping entries win; sentinel: `compile_coding_register` binds the sentinel book outside its periods, or binds a period whose 99 is not exactly 'Unknown'
